# netbox_ip_address (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox ip addres (`/api/ipam/ip-addresses/`) by `id`, `address` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_ip_address" "example" {
  address = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_ip_address" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address.
- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/ipam/ip-addresses/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) Assigned Object Id.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) Assigned Object Type.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `dns_name` (String) Hostname or FQDN (not case-sensitive). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `family` (Number) Family.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `nat_inside_id` (Number) The IP for which this address is the "outside" IP. References `netbox_ip_address`.
- `nat_outside_ids` (Set of Number) Nat Outside. References `netbox_ip_address`.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `role` (String) The functional role of this IP. Valid values: `loopback`, `secondary`, `anycast`, `vip`, `vrrp`, `hsrp`, `glbp`, `carp`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) The operational status of this IP. Valid values: `active`, `reserved`, `deprecated`, `dhcp`, `slaac`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `url` (String) Url.
- `vrf_id` (Number) ID of the Vrf (`netbox_vrf`).

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
